repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

queue.description: Whether pulls land on it only through the merge queue.

merges.description: Whether it takes merge commits; otherwise pulls merge into it squashed.

reviews.description: The reviews a pull needs before it merges into the branch. Absent, none.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The account logged in is not the repository's owner.

main.description: Adds the branch to the protected branches of the repository's dev.knotless.repo record, in place of any rule it had, as `knotless branch protect` does: through the gateway it then only moves forward, is never deleted, and unless merges is set takes no merge commits; with queue, pulls land on it only through the merge queue; with reviews, a pull merges into it only once reviewed as they ask. Its owner can, logged in to this appview's web pages: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account, which the pages' session cookie names. For an organization's repository, so can an admin who joined it, logged in to the pages or with a service token from their own PDS for this method: the appview's gateway, which the organization delegated its writes to, writes as the organization.

description: Protects a branch of a repository.
